test_title: PYST 27: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Simon __is afraid of closed space__.
solution:
The correct answer is ** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Claustrophobia is the fear of closed or confined spaces.
 
• **Claustrophobia** is commonly experienced in elevators, small rooms, and crowded areas.
 
• It is a type of** anxiety disorder** and can be treated with therapy and counseling.
 
• **People with claustrophobia** often avoid places and situations where they might feel trapped or confined.​.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *Simon **has claustrophobia**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Xenophobia **is the fear of strangers or foreigners.
 
• **Ecophobia** is the fear of home surroundings or the home environment.
 
• **Hydrophobia** is the fear of water.
